latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Subtitle Generator — Generate and Embed Video Subtitles:

- Upload video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and generate accurate subtitles to export as captioned 1080p MP4 videos.
- Automatic session setup and cloud processing; no local install or GitHub repo required.
- Supports caption generation, video uploads, downloads, credits check, and session state queries.
- Fast processing (30–90 seconds for typical clips); best results with short clips under 2 minutes.
- Exports ready-to-post videos with subtitles for content creators and developers.
